title: feat(cloudflare): choose which zones are collected

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge Contained change: every new write is org-scoped and admin-checked, and the poller behavior is pinned by six new service tests. 1 note · tests covered · risk medium · 3/3 new units observable Adds per-account Cloudflare zone selection: a new `cloudflare_zone_settings` table, a poller that reconciles it on every discovery pass, an admin-only `PUT /cloudflare/zones`, and a Manage zones dialog. Safe to merge; the only issue is one vacuous assertion in a new test. - Zone choices live in `cloudflare_zone_settings`, applied by `reconcileZones` on every discovery pass - `setZoneSettings` pauses or resumes only the zones whose stored choice changed - `PUT /cloudflare/zones` is admin-only and records `cloudflare_integration.zones_updated` - The zone board gains a Manage zones dialog with a per-account draft ### Before merge - [ ] **Migration** · Check it is safe on production data and with the code still deployed · [`packages/db/drizzle/20261029152015_cloudflare_zone_settings/migration.sql`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/187045610d2e4172c09ea67f63fdcc6d519f578a/packages/db/drizzle/20261029152015_cloudflare_zone_settings/migration.sql) ### Findings
🔵 Note · F1 · isSavingZones assertion in the new scene test cannot fail tests · [`apps/web/src/page/integrations/cloudflare-zones.scene.test.ts:154`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/187045610d2e4172c09ea67f63fdcc6d519f578a/apps/web/src/page/integrations/cloudflare-zones.scene.test.ts#L154) The model comes from `connected()`, which never runs `submittedZoneSettings`, so `isSavingZones` is already `false` when `CompletedCloudflareZones` arrives; the assertion passes even if `completedZoneSettings` stopped resetting the flag, and the dialog closure the test name claims is never asserted. Drive a real Save first — click, resolve `SaveCloudflareZones`, then assert the dialog model is closed and the flag reset. ``` Make the test go through `Message.SubmittedZoneSettings` (click Save, then `Command.resolve(SaveCloudflareZones, ...)`) before asserting the flag and that `cloudflareCard.zoneDialog` is closed. ```
### Production impact
Production traffic of the changed files (last 7 days) | File | Calls/day | Busiest operations | | --- | ---: | --- | | `packages/backend/src/services/integrations/CloudflareAnalyticsService.ts` | 45 | `CloudflareAnalyticsService.getStatus` 45/day, 0.0% err |
Telemetry this change adds and removes (4) - ➕ attribute `maple.cloudflare.zones_unwatched` · `packages/backend/src/services/integrations/CloudflareAnalyticsService.ts:1522` - ➕ span name `CloudflareAnalyticsService.setZoneSettings` · `packages/backend/src/services/integrations/CloudflareAnalyticsService.ts:3315` - ➕ attribute `maple.cloudflare.rows_paused` · `packages/backend/src/services/integrations/CloudflareAnalyticsService.ts:3388` - ➕ attribute `maple.cloudflare.rows_resumed` · `packages/backend/src/services/integrations/CloudflareAnalyticsService.ts:3389`
What was checked - Paused zones really leave the poll plan: `!row.enabled` is skipped at `CloudflareAnalyticsService.ts:801` and `:1078`, so health and budget drop them - Both new reads filter `OrgId` and the PUT calls `requireAdmin` (`apps/api/src/routes/internal/integrations.http.ts:477`), so no cross-tenant or non-admin write - New state rows are inserted with `enabled: isZoneWatched(...)` (`:1543`), so a paused zone never reaches a GraphQL `zoneTags` list
Observability coverage: 3 of 3 changes observable | Change | Kind | Observable | Evidence | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `CloudflareAnalyticsService.setZoneSettings` zone pause/resume write | service method | yes | `Effect.fn` span plus `maple.cloudflare.rows_paused`/`rows_resumed` (`CloudflareAnalyticsService.ts:3315,3387`) | | `reconcileZones` discovery pass applying the stored choice | background worker step | yes | `Effect.fn` span plus `maple.cloudflare.zones_unwatched` (`CloudflareAnalyticsService.ts:1511,1521`) | | `PUT /cloudflare/zones` inbound endpoint | http handler | yes | Effect HttpApi auto-instrumentation covers the route, as for every other handler in `integrations.http.ts` |
